title: Outer Wilds
description: Explore a mysterious solar system trapped in an endless time loop. Every 22 minutes, the sun goes supernova and you wake up at the campfire — until you uncover the truth behind the ancient alien ruins.

title: Journey
description: Glide through vast deserts toward a distant mountain. A wordless, stunning adventure that you might share with a stranger — no voice chat, no names, just two figures in the sand.

title: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit your grandfather's farm and build a new life in Pelican Town. Farm, fish, mine, and form friendships in this endlessly cozy farming RPG.

title: Hollow Knight
description: Descend into Hallownest, a vast underground kingdom of insects and heroes. A challenging action-platformer with a haunting atmosphere and 40+ hours of exploration.

title: Rocket League
description: Soccer meets high-powered rockets in this high-octane, physics-based sports game. Easy to learn, nearly impossible to master — perfect for competitive multiplayer sessions.

title: Among Us
description: Complete tasks on a spaceship — or sabotage them as the hidden Impostor. A social deduction game that is at its best in a living room full of screaming friends.

title: Minecraft
description: Build anything you can imagine, from a simple cabin to a working computer — or just survive the night. The definitive sandbox experience with infinite replayability.

title: Celeste
description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain. A brutally challenging but deeply rewarding platformer with a touching story about mental health.

title: It Takes Two
description: A couple on the verge of divorce are magically transformed into dolls. Work together through wildly creative co-op gameplay to fix your relationship — literally.

title: Hades
description: Battle your way out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler. Each run is different, every death teaches you something, and the story unfolds through hundreds of conversations with Greek gods.

title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Build and decorate your own island paradise at your own pace. Fish, catch bugs, plant flowers, and invite adorable animal villagers to live with you.

title: LIMBO
description: A boy enters LIMBO — a stark black-and-white world full of deadly traps — searching for his sister. A short, haunting puzzle-platformer you won't forget.

title: Forza Horizon 5
description: Race through a stunning open-world Mexico with hundreds of cars. Whether you prefer competitive online racing or just cruising to a sunset, there's a race for every mood.

title: Unpacking
description: Unpack boxes and arrange belongings into a new home. A zen puzzle game that tells a wordless life story through the objects we carry with us.

title: Overcooked! 2
description: Cook meals and serve customers in increasingly chaotic kitchens — moving platforms, portals, and sushi conveyor belts included. The best and worst co-op game for couples.
